docs.title: What this is
docs.text:
This handbook is the learning environment for the Augmented Software Engineering foundation.

It combines software engineering fundamentals with modern AI-assisted development practices.

The goal is not simply to learn tools, but to learn how to use them effectively while understanding the software being built.

docs.text:

  • Projects

    Put everything together by building real things.
